structuredContent.description: Standalone SMALL MAGE METEOR / stony comet sprite for a top-down dark fantasy pixel-art game. One chipped angular grey-green slate and bronze rock, about 32 pixels wide, head centered at pixel (53,79). Three large readable stone facets with upper-left lighting, ONE narrow warm amber heated edge and a tiny hot seam. A SHORT tapered amber-copper flame wake points UPPER RIGHT along an exactly 45-degree diagonal, toward (91,41); the rock travels LOWER LEFT along this axis. Overall visible footprint about 70 by 70 pixels, keep generous transparent margins. It must look like a modest spell of a mortal mage: noticeably smaller, calmer and less powerful than a volcanic boss meteor. No spherical lava boulder, molten cracked plates, glowing lava network, infernal smoke pillar, big shockwave or boss ornament. Original design, not a smaller copy of an existing boss sprite. Coherent low-to-medium detail, chunky crisp clusters, restrained selective outline. One object only, no ground, impact, characters, UI, sheet or background.
